items.title: Is el clásico still the world’s biggest match? Three questions before Barcelona v Real Madrid
items.summary: The fixture’s relevance waned as the Messi-Ronaldo rivalry faded. Can Lamine Yamal and Mbappé lift it into a new era?For the best part of a decade, el clásico was more than just soccer’s biggest fixture. It was the defining narrative.
